answer: The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, reset on any identity-link attempt, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. By the opal of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Work waits on the tundra until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the atlas of the next round.
